questions.stem:
Practice form 3.
Which method is most likely to produce a representative sample?

options.A: Survey only volunteers from one club.
options.B: Survey the first ten students entering one class.
options.C: Select students at random from the full school roster.
options.D: Survey only students who already agree.

questions.explanation: Random selection from the full population reduces selection bias.
